text: The most perfect reverence and resignation becomes us, but I cannot help depending upon this, that the present dreadful calamity of that beloved town is intended to bind the colonies together in more indissoluble bonds, and to animate their exertions at this great crisis in the affairs of mankind.
author: John Adams
reference: Familiar Letters of John Adams and His Wife Abigail Adams
locator: Letter 31, John Adams to Abigail Adams
